summary: Final record for this run, filed as a single durable Fact rather than another construction, since the budget is nearly spent and both actor-layer mechanisms are settled and reproduced. The Fact states what spans them: a successful `append_notify` resolution does not entail that the caller's entry is at the returned index, because the assignment is only `(index, ballot at assignment)`, the success arm fires on the decided index alone, and the repository's own caller treats that resolution as durable confirmation of the entry at that index without reading the log there while the existing runtime test only asserts a non-zero index and a non-empty suffix. It names the two independent mechanisms that produce that shape — the arm order (an entry dropped by a leader change resolving `Ok` on the replaced index) and the placeholder accounting (a truncation discarding queued entries and shifting the index reported) — with its conditions, the caller-side boundary that leaves a verifying caller untouched, and the receipts. No source correction was implied, so the per-mechanism accounts and their conditions stay as recorded. Over the run the record now holds three asserted defects with complete comparison chains — the arm-order false success with its measured tick band, the shifted index with its six-configuration condition, and the core trim path unable to compact when the largest node id exceeds the node count — plus two bounded negatives on out-of-order delivery and on duplication with stale-leader replay, one unreproduced suspicion that was corrected rather than kept, and the source rules that explain each condition. Validation reports the update valid with no execution requested.
